Let’s make it clear: The node is always on the top left.

How do I add a Node to the canvas in Webflow?

Webflow adds new nodes and edges to the Canvas as soon as you drag them from your toolbox. To delete one, simply click on it directly with your mouse or press Command + Backspace (Control + Backspace on Windows). In general, we like it when everything flows.

How do graphs work in Webflow?

Graphs are made up of a network of connected nodes and edges. Here, each circle is called a node , and lines connecting them indicate the relationship between these nodes . This type of graph can show any kind of hierarchical organizational structure.

How does Webflow know if you have enough space on your canvas for a new node?

This can happen: When Webflow knows that there isn’t enough space left on its canvas to add another element. To ensure Webflow knows where the next element will go, move an element one pixel at a time until it’s exactly as close as you need. This will make Webflow understand better.

What do the nodes in a graph represent?

With an understanding of what a node is and how graphs work, we can now think about what they represent. In this graph, all the circles are called nodes , which is probably no shocker given that they resemble circular balls or dots. But they don’t have to be round circles!
